How We Work

Structured Delivery. Full Transparency.

Delivery Process

Five Phases. One Proven Framework.

01

Discovery & Kickoff

Stakeholder interviews, backlog review, architecture assessment and sprint-zero planning.

02

Sprint Planning

Story mapping, effort estimation, sprint capacity allocation and definition of done.

03

Agile Delivery

2-week sprints with daily standups, demo at sprint end, retrospective and backlog grooming.

04

QA & Security

Automated testing, performance benchmarking, OWASP security checks and code review gates.

05

Release & Handover

Staged rollout, UAT support, documentation, knowledge transfer and hypercare period.

Governance Framework

Transparency at Every Level.

Weekly Reports
Sprint velocity, burn-down charts, risk register and blocker escalation — delivered every Friday.
Jira / Confluence
Full transparency with shared Jira boards, Confluence documentation and real-time dashboards.
Dedicated Coordinator
A single point of contact for scheduling, escalation, resource changes and stakeholder communication.
Executive Reviews
Monthly steering-committee reviews with leadership, covering roadmap, budget and strategic alignment.

Engagement Models

Three Ways to Work Together. Pick Yours.

Dedicated Team
A full cross-functional squad — developers, QA, BA and scrum master — embedded in your delivery org. You set the priorities; we deliver the sprints.

Best for: Long-term programs, product development, ongoing enhancement backlogs.

Project-Based
Fixed-scope, fixed-timeline delivery with milestone-based billing. We own the plan, the build and the release — you own the outcome.

Best for: Greenfield builds, platform migrations, compliance-driven projects.

Staff Augmentation
Certified professionals plugged into your existing team within days. Managed by you, supported by our bench and training academy.

Best for: Skill gaps, surge capacity, specific certifications needed fast.

01
